reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Support for MirrorMaker 1 has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: migration-required

consequence.statement: MirrorMaker 1 support has been removed; environments using MirrorMaker 1 must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46 or newer.
consequence.remediation: Migrate existing MirrorMaker 1 deployments to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading Strimzi to version 0.46.0 or later.

proposed.statement: Support for MirrorMaker 1 has been removed in Strimzi 0.46.0; users must migrate to MirrorMaker 2 before upgrading.
